product_from_film: Airbound builds a compact winged drone, shown through design, fabrication, assembly and outdoor flight.
explains_well: The recurring checked material and wing form link workshop processes to the finished aircraft.
unclear: No delivery, payload or customer scene explains what the aircraft is intended to do.
scenario: Show an aircraft progressing from design and materials to flight.
product_clear_basis: A recognizable winged aircraft with propellers is visible in the technical product views around 18s.

categories.finding: Design → material fabrication → assembly → completed aircraft → outdoor flight → brand.

categories.finding: The making-to-flight story works silently. Intended use and comparative performance remain unclear.

Add one use-case payoff after flight.
